title: pkix-lint ParameterError missing serde and Send+Sync assertion
description:
pkix_lint::ParameterError derives Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq but lacks:
1. #[cfg_attr(feature = "serde", derive(serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize))] - despite the crate having a serde Cargo feature and applying it to Finding, DeviatedFinding, EvaluationReport (the other public types in the same crate).
2. Send + Sync compile-time assertion - the crate has one for other types but ParameterError is not covered.

ParameterError is a public error type returned by the Lint::set_parameter trait method. Under AGENTS.md non-negotiable #6, it should derive serde behind the feature flag and have the Send+Sync assertion like the crate's other public types.

Impact: Callers building a parameter-configuration pipeline that serializes errors cannot include ParameterError values. This is a niche case (Lint::set_parameter is for runtime parameter tuning) but breaks the uniformity guarantee.

Location: /home/mark/PROJECT/PKIX/pkix-lint/src/lib.rs (ParameterError definition)
